items.copy:

items.title: GTM Rebrands
items.copy:
Clients often plan a global rebrand around a 6-month timeline. Then reality arrives: permit approvals, landlord sign-off, manufacturing lead times, dozens of local systems that don't move on your schedule.
We've seen a single building permit take 15 months because of local hurricane legislation. Combine that with a 12-month IPO deadline and you have a genuine problem.
Bring an execution partner in early. Within a few minutes of reviewing the plans, we can give you a realistic timeline, phased around permitting, landlord cycles and logistics.
Want the full breakdown of the five traps that catch most rebrands out? Read the Execution Gap. Link below.

items.title: 10 Questions Thought Leadership
items.copy:

The ones underneath.We gathered them over months of conversations across retail, FMCG, financial services and hospitality, then asked the room to rank them. Three came out well ahead: AI, risk and cost. Here’s question one. The one the room ranked hottest.
